title: Christ Is Made the Sure Foundation
description: Christ Is Made the Sure Foundation in Tonic Solfa to WESTMINSTER ABBEY: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the five verses, and a piano.
about: John Mason Neale translated the Latin hymn in 1851; Hymns Ancient and Modern prints these verses as the second part of his translation. The tune WESTMINSTER ABBEY comes from Henry Purcell (1680).
underlay: Christ is made the sure Foun-da-tion, Christ the Head_ and Cor-ner-stone, Cho-sen of the Lord, and pre-cious, Bind-ing all_ the Church in one, Ho-ly Si-on’s help for ev-er, And her con-fi-dence a-lone.

lines: Christ is made the sure Foundation,
Chosen of the Lord, and precious,
Binding all the Church in one,
Dearly loved of God on high,
God the One in Three adoring
To this temple, where we call Thee,
Come, O Lord of hosts, to-day;
Hear Thy servants, as they pray;
Here vouchsafe to all Thy servants
What they ask of Thee to gain,
What they gain from Thee for ever
Laud and honour to the Father,
Laud and honour to the Son,
Laud and honour to the Spirit,
